title: A Return to the Classroom
text:
A Return to the Classroom"

"Tehran - September 21 - President Masoud Pezeshkian inaugurated Iran’s new academic year on Tuesday by ringing the ceremonial school bell at a girls’ school in Tehran’s District 18 (Yaftabad neighborhood), marking a pivotal moment for a nation emerging from an extended period of remote education. "

"This academic year carries particular significance, as it represents Iran’s full-scale return to in-person instruction following months of nationwide school closures that had forced approximately 16.6 million students across 117,140 schools into virtual learning. The prolonged shift to online education had placed immense strain on families, particularly working parents with young children, and raised concerns about learning loss and educational equity."

"Education Minister Kazemi had previously emphasized the government’s determination to restore classroom instruction, stating: “Even under the most difficult conditions, we will firmly continue with in-person classes”. The return to physical classrooms has been described by officials as a critical step toward educational recovery and normalization."

" International Engagement Ahead"

"Following the school ceremony, President Pezeshkian is scheduled to depart Tehran’s Mehrabad Airport for New York to participate in the United Nations General Assembly, underscoring Iran’s continued engagement on the international stage.
